_comment: MATHMON RECOVERY CENTER (MCR) interior. Background art: assets/backgrounds/village_recovery_interior.png (from 'Interior Mathmon Recovery Center (MCR).jpeg'); collision from tools/process_building_art.py. The nurse and the information desk are part of the painting, so their interactables are painted. Drawn at half size (15 x 9 tiles) so the painted nurse matches the characters' size. painted_actors: people in the painting who breathe and talk (game/overworld.py PaintedActor); npcs: visitors walking between the waypoints.
name: Mathmon Recovery Center

interactables.name: Nurse Hana
interactables.title: NURSE HANA
text: Welcome to the Mathmon Recovery Center! Our Recovery Chamber runs on maths.

interactables.name: information desk
interactables.title: TOURIST INFORMATION
text: Mathea has four worlds: Number Forest, the Algebra Cavern, the Geometry Kingdom and the Chronos Dimension.
Each world's camp has a Recovery Station. Solve problems there to heal on the road!

npcs.name: Kai
lines: My VOLTIX lost to a wild DIVOWL. Division is hard when you're tired!
Nurse Hana asked me three questions. I got two - good enough for a nap.
remarks: I should practise my times tables.

npcs.name: Mia
lines: Did you know the capsule glows greener as your MathMon gets better?
I'm waiting for my AQUABIT. It swallowed a negative number.

npcs.name: Old Pell
lines: In my day the capsules ran on long division. You young ones have it easy!
Read the information desk. Knowledge is the best medicine.

painted_actors.name: Nurse Hana
remarks: Every right answer powers the capsule.
Rest is part of training too!
Fractions heal fastest. Don't ask me why.

painted_actors.name: Receptionist
remarks: The capsule fits one MathMon at a time.
Visiting hours: whenever you need us.
Please sign the guest book... in numbers!
